title: Basic chat completes with a full answer ending in a complete sentence
description: From a new chat on /app, a basic question streams a non-empty answer that finishes with sentence-ending punctuation (not truncated mid-word). Verifies FR1.1 and the G1 truncation fix at the UI level.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to http://localhost:3000/app
In the composer on /app, type exactly 'jelaskan singkat apa itu spaced repetition' and press Enter
A user message bubble appears containing the text 'jelaskan singkat apa itu spaced repetition'
The agent begins streaming: the composer's send control becomes a Stop button and a shimmering indicator reading 'Astra sedang berpikir…' or 'Astra sedang menyusun jawaban…' is visible
Wait up to 90 seconds until streaming finishes (the Stop button reverts to the send control and a copy icon plus a regenerate circular-arrow icon appear under the answer)
The assistant answer is non-empty and ends with a complete sentence: the final visible character is sentence-ending punctuation such as '.', '!', '?', or '…', i.e. it is not cut off mid-word

title: Streaming shows Stop control, then reverts to send with copy/regenerate (FR1.2, AC1.2)
description: While an answer streams the composer shows a Stop button; after completion the control returns to the send arrow and copy/regenerate icons appear.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
In the composer type exactly 'tuliskan esai 4 paragraf tentang manfaat membaca buku' and press Enter
While the answer is streaming, the composer shows a Stop button (not the send arrow)
Wait up to 90 seconds for the answer to finish streaming
After completion the control returns to the send arrow and a copy icon plus a regenerate (circular arrow) icon are shown under the answer

title: Empty send is blocked (AC1.3)
description: Pressing Enter on an empty composer does not send a message, does not create a thread, and keeps the URL on /app.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to http://localhost:3000/app
Ensure the composer is empty (no text) and press Enter without typing anything
No message bubble is added and no assistant streaming begins
No new thread is created and the URL stays on http://localhost:3000/app (it does not navigate to /app/threads/<id>)

title: Slash command menu lists 10 commands in 3 sections; selecting Deep research enters deep mode (AC2.1, AC2.2)
description: Typing '/' opens a grouped command menu of exactly 10 commands; typing 'deep' and selecting Deep research attaches a deep mode chip to the composer.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
In the composer type a single '/' character
A command menu opens listing 10 commands grouped into three sections titled 'Tulis Akademik', 'Rancang Riset', and 'Workspace'
The menu includes all of: /paraphrase, /expand, /summarize, /outline, /research-question, /methodology, /literature-review, /deep, /artifact, /workspace
Continue typing 'deep' to filter, then select the 'Deep research' item
The composer shows a 'deep' chip/mode and is ready to accept a research question

title: Stop mid-stream is clean with no AbortError (regression, fix G5)
description: Clicking Stop while streaming halts cleanly, keeps the partial text, and surfaces no error overlay/banner/'1 Issue' badge and no 'AbortError: BodyStreamBuffer was aborted'.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
In the composer type exactly 'tuliskan esai panjang dan rinci tentang sejarah kopi di dunia' and press Enter
Wait until a few paragraphs have streamed and the answer is still streaming (Stop button visible), then click the Stop button
Streaming halts immediately, the already-streamed partial text remains visible, and the control returns to the send arrow
No error overlay, red error banner, or '1 Issue' badge appears, and the message 'AbortError: BodyStreamBuffer was aborted' does NOT appear anywhere

title: Regenerate does not duplicate the user message (regression, fix G6)
description: Regenerating a completed answer produces a fresh answer for the same question without adding a second copy of the user's message bubble.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
In the composer type exactly 'jelaskan singkat apa itu spaced repetition' and press Enter, then wait up to 90 seconds for the answer to finish (copy + regenerate icons visible)
Click the regenerate (circular arrow) icon under the completed answer
A new answer is generated for the same question
The user's message 'jelaskan singkat apa itu spaced repetition' still appears exactly once above the regenerated answer; it is NOT duplicated into a second user bubble

title: Refresh while streaming resumes and completes (best-effort, timing-sensitive, fix G1)
description: Reloading the page mid-stream resumes the in-progress answer and the final answer is complete, not truncated. Mark inconclusive if the mid-stream window is missed.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
In the composer type exactly 'tuliskan panduan komprehensif dan sangat panjang tentang pola tidur sehat' and press Enter
As soon as a few paragraphs have streamed (still streaming, Stop button visible), reload the current thread page in the browser
After reload the thread is not empty: the in-progress answer continues to stream or is already completed (no lost run)
Wait up to 90 seconds for streaming to settle after the reload

The final answer is complete, ending with sentence-ending punctuation ('.', '!', '?', or '…') and not truncated mid-sentence. If the refresh landed after completion, a full answer still passes. If the exact mid-stream window was missed, mark the test inconclusive rather than failed.

title: Document artifact card survives a page refresh (regression, fix G7)
description: Asking Astra to create a short document yields a document artifact card in the thread that remains visible after reloading the page.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
In the composer type exactly 'buatkan dokumen catatan singkat berisi 3 tips belajar efektif' and press Enter
If the agent asks a clarifying question, reply briefly with 'untuk mahasiswa, bahasa Indonesia' so it proceeds; approve in conversation if prompted
A document artifact card showing a title and the label 'Dokumen' appears in the thread (wait up to 120 seconds)
Reload the current thread page in the browser
After reload, the document artifact card is still visible in the thread (it is not lost)

title: Destructive delete approval card; approving deletes with no stream error (regression, fix G8, AC5.3)
description: Requesting deletion of an existing artifact surfaces an approval card ending 'Setujui untuk menjalankan.'; approving removes the card and confirms deletion with no 'tool_result must be preceded by a tool_call' error.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app

First ensure an artifact exists: type 'buatkan dokumen catatan singkat berisi 3 tips belajar efektif', press Enter, answer any clarifying question with 'untuk mahasiswa, bahasa Indonesia', and wait until a document artifact card (title + 'Dokumen') appears
In the same thread type exactly 'tolong hapus artefak yang tadi' and press Enter
An approval card appears containing a line ending with 'Setujui untuk menjalankan.' and two buttons labeled 'Setujui' and 'Tolak'
Click the 'Setujui' button
The agent confirms deletion (text such as 'Sudah dihapus') and the artifact card is removed from the thread
No error overlay or '1 Issue' badge appears, and the stream error 'tool_result must be preceded by a tool_call' does NOT appear

title: /deep shows a plan-gate before researching (fix G2, AC4.1)
description: A /deep research question produces a 'Rencana riset' plan card with sub-questions and approve/reject buttons, and research does NOT start until approval.
category: Deep research plan and cited synthesis

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
Select /deep from the slash menu (or type '/deep '), then type exactly 'apa efek konsumsi kafein terhadap kualitas tidur pada orang dewasa?' and send
Wait up to 90 seconds for the plan step to appear

A card titled 'Rencana riset' appears containing a prose plan paragraph, a bullet list of sub-questions, the line 'Setujui untuk memulai riset, atau tolak untuk membatalkan.', and two buttons labeled 'Setujui' and 'Tolak'
Research has NOT started yet: no final cited answer and no sources panel are present at this point

title: Approve /deep produces cited synthesis with a sources panel (long-running, fix G2/G3/G4, AC4.2-4.4)
description: Approving the /deep plan runs a process trace and yields a structured answer with inline [1]/[2] citation markers and an expandable 'N sumber' sources panel whose numbers match the prose.
category: Deep research plan and cited synthesis

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
Select /deep (or type '/deep '), type exactly 'apa efek konsumsi kafein terhadap kualitas tidur pada orang dewasa?', send, and wait up to 90 seconds for the 'Rencana riset' plan card
Click the 'Setujui' button to start the research

Wait up to 240 seconds; a process trace runs with steps such as 'Menelaah literatur', 'Mencari bukti tandingan', 'Memverifikasi sitasi', 'Menulis sintesis', and a live elapsed label starting with 'Sedang bekerja' ticks
A final structured answer appears containing inline citation markers such as [1] and [2]
Click the sources toggle that reads 'N sumber' (e.g. '12 sumber') to expand the sources list
The expanded sources list shows sources each prefixed with a bracketed number [1] / [2] / … that match the citation markers used in the prose

title: Reject the /deep plan stops research
description: Clicking 'Tolak' on a /deep plan card cancels the research; no literature search or cited synthesis is produced.
category: Deep research plan and cited synthesis

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
Run a deep research request: select /deep (or type '/deep '), type exactly 'apa dampak olahraga pagi terhadap produktivitas?', send, and wait up to 90 seconds for the 'Rencana riset' plan card
Click the 'Tolak' button
The agent stops and does not proceed into research: no process trace, no cited synthesis answer, and no 'N sumber' sources panel are produced

title: Ambiguous query makes the agent ask for context (AC5.2)
description: An ambiguous question prompts a plain-text clarification request rather than a confident answer; no buttoned card is required.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
In a fresh chat, type exactly 'bandingkan dua pendekatan itu untuk proyek saya' and press Enter
Wait up to 90 seconds for the answer to settle

The agent replies as plain text asking for clarification/context (e.g. it asks which two approaches are meant or what the project is), rather than producing a confident answer. No approval/buttoned card is required.

title: Refresh during a running /deep resumes (best-effort, fix G1 for workflow)
description: Reloading while the deep-research process trace runs resumes the run (process trace / 'Sedang bekerja' continues or completes with cited answer + sources); the thread must not silently become empty. Mark inconclusive if timing is missed.
category: Deep research plan and cited synthesis

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form and wait until redirected to /app
Select /deep (or type '/deep '), type exactly 'apa manfaat dan risiko puasa intermiten?', send, and wait up to 90 seconds for the 'Rencana riset' plan card
Click the 'Setujui' button to start the research
While the research process trace is running (the 'Sedang bekerja' label is ticking), reload the current thread page in the browser

After reload the thread still shows the deep-research run: either still in progress (process trace / 'Sedang bekerja' resumes) or completed with the cited answer + 'N sumber' sources. The thread must NOT be silently lost/empty. If the timing window was missed, mark inconclusive rather than failed.
